text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each generator's paired difference, with the same month-resampling. The six generators share one nearest station and two ERA5 grid cells, so they are not six independent replications. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire. The ENS and station panels are scored on different rows. All rows are exploratory.'
